clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Razorfen Kraul, Heralath Fallowbrook lies dying in quilboar hands. Sent to investigate the briars around Ancient Agamaggan's remains, he was captured and brutalized. Now he hopes word of his fate and his cherished pendant will reach his wife in Darnassus.

Heralath Fallowbrook came to the southern Barrens to investigate Ancient Agamaggan and the briars spreading around his remains. Sent by his people, the night elf druid sought the source of Razorfen Kraul's corruption. The quilboar captured him instead and locked him in a pen, where beatings and fever left him with mortal wounds. Before he faded, Heralath told Henrig Lonebrow, a dwarf captive, what he had learned. He urged Henrig to warn the sentinel outpost at Thalanaar about the aggression stirred by Charlga Razorflank, the quilboar crone.
